title: Manner in which declaration of quantity shall be
additional_rules: Mass declaration may additionally state number of commodities.
Where quantity alone is insufficient, dimensions or number must also be declared where necessary.
Additional necessary information should appear on the same panel as required information.
Quantity declaration must not create an exaggerated, misleading or inadequate impression.
small_package_rule: For capacity 5 cubic cm or less, quantity may be on a non-removable tag/card/tape/device with identifying mark or inscription.
